impact.text: each time receiving additional bonus tokens that should only have been granted once

precondition_sources.text: The original lock being split is an SM-NFT.

intent_sources.text: The SM-NFT bonus must be granted only once, at the time of lock creation, and must not be reapplied during a split.
The split function must not apply calculate_sm_nft_bonus even when the lock is marked as an SM-NFT.
